title: Bomberman (Classic NES)
sources: own knowledge of the NES original

widgets.text: Ballom (slow), Onil, Dahl, Minvo, Doria (passes walls), Ovape, Pass (fast, smart), Pontan (very fast). Bombing the exit spawns more enemies.
50 stages; each hides an exit door and one power-up under soft blocks. Defeat all enemies, then step on the exit. Bonus stages every few levels.
Power-ups stay until you lose a life (except the stage's special ones).
A 20-letter password after each stage restores the stage and your power-ups. Write it down: the Classic NES cart has no other save.
Clear all 50 stages; the timer (200 s) brings fast enemies when it hits 0.
